episodes.title: Epstein Commission Report; Federal Housing Law | Full Episode
episodes.description:
This week on New Mexico in Focus, we head to Santa Fe as New Mexico's Epstein Truth Commission releases its interim report on Zorro Ranch. We hear from the lawmakers who put it together, as well as a survivor of Jeffery Epstein who testified before the House committee. 

The 21st Century Road to Housing Act, a package of four bills meant to address a nationwide housing crisis, became law last month. Isidoro Hernandez, executive director of Housing New Mexico, and Elizabeth Elia, an attorney with the New Mexico Center for Housing Law, sit down with Nash to discuss how the new law could change things in our state. 

With a 2-1 vote, the state's Public Regulation Commission approved the sale of New Mexico Gas Company to Bernhard Capital Partners, a Louisiana-based private equity group. Nash breaks down the details of the acquisition and the pushback. 

Scientists at New Mexico State University have created an alternative to blood to fuel mosquito research. Ph.D. Candidate Anjali Kari speaks with Nash about the development of "SkitoSnack," and how it could help researchers around the globe mitigate the risks of the disease-carrying insects.

episodes.title: NM Epstein Truth Commission Chair on Scope of Investigation
episodes.description:
3.6.26 – Earlier this year, the state House of Representatives unanimously approved a resolution creating a subcommittee to investigate possible crimes committed at Jeffrey Epstein's former Zorro Ranch in Northern New Mexico. Democratic Rep. Andrea Romero chairs this new group, now known as the "Epstein Truth Commission." Romero recently joined Senior Producer Lou DiVizio to explain the commission's work, and why she believes New Mexicans deserve to know the truth. 

Correspondent: 
Lou DiVizio 

Guest: 
NM Rep. Andrea Romero, D-Santa Fe; Epstein Truth Commission Chair   

For More Information: 
https://www.abqjournal.com/news/epstein-truth-finding-commission-plans-to-start-issuing-subpoenas-to-persons-of-interest/2982720
